question:
Select the word segment that can substitute the bracketed word segment correctly and complete the sentence meaningfully.

(Each participant have) performed well.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Each participant have"** is grammatically incorrect. The correct auxiliary verb should be singular to match the singular noun "participant".
 
• **"Each participant has"** means that every individual participant **has performed well.** (प्रत्येक प्रतिभागी ने अच्छा प्रदर्शन किया है।)
 
 
• **Example: **Each participant has submitted their project on time.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Each participant was** (प्रत्येक प्रतिभागी था): This phrase is incorrect in the given context as it does not correctly complete the sentence.

 
 
• **Example:** Each participant was eager to win.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Each participant have been** (प्रत्येक प्रतिभागी रहे हैं): This phrase is grammatically incorrect as "have" does not agree with the singular noun "participant".
 
 
• **Example: **Each participant have been preparing for months. (Incorrect)
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Each participant were** (प्रत्येक प्रतिभागी थे): This phrase is incorrect because "were" does not agree with the singular noun "participant".
 
 
• **Example: **Each participant were given a certificate. (Incorrect)
